//: Standalone (does NOT extend tsconfig.base.json): base is a bundler/no-emit config with allowImportingTsExtensions, but this package is a real Node ESM CLI that tsc must EMIT to dist/. So it uses NodeNext resolution + .js relative specifiers (the runtime-correct form for emitted ESM), which is why its imports break the repo's usual '.ts extension' rule.
//exclude: TASK-N2-A1. This project EMITS to dist/, and dist/ is what npm publishes -- so anything excluded here is excluded from the shipped tarball, and anything forgotten here ships. Specs and the fixture catalog are test-time only. `src/**/*.test.ts` is kept alongside `*.spec.ts` so a file that drifts back to the old name is still not published; the spec that must not drift back is `yarn validate:mcp`, which fails when a tool has no `*.spec.ts` block. Typechecking of the excluded files is tsconfig.test.json, wired into `yarn typecheck:all`.
